summary: From Ward's call with Andrew Edwards (ex-Microsoft): Microsoft's self-build side runs land acquisition and permitting across Europe (pan-European, then focus regions). Jean-François Berche's team runs Partnerships: everything between a standard lease and self-build, i.e. JVs, direct acquisitions and hybrid delivery models. Andrew described Microsoft as a big, bureaucratic organisation. Before Microsoft he delivered a data centre in Abu Dhabi for Masdar / Khazna / G42, working for the landowner Mubadala.

source.subject: How Microsoft's data centre land and partnerships teams are split
